thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert: metering-ingest-consumer-lag CRITICAL fired for account: billing-pipeline
pagerduty-bot: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/PD12345 — Escalation policy: metering-oncall. Notify: alex, maya, lee
alex: acked oncall. I'm looking. what services are showing most lag?
maya: consumer-group 'metering-ingest-v2' showing 1.2M msgs backlog, consumer lag ~45m, partitions 24. kafka offsets not moving.
jon: saw same on Dashboards — consumer error rate spike around 21:04 UTC. logs show Rebalance loops on pod metering-consumer-3
alex: pulling logs now. running: kubectl -n metering get pods | grep consumer
alex: logs (tail):
```
2026-03-14T21:04:12Z ERROR CommitFailedException: timeout committing offset
2026-03-14T21:04:13Z WARN Rebalance triggered, leaving group
2026-03-14T21:04:14Z ERROR Processing record id=abc123 failed: OutOfMemoryError
```
maya: OOM looks likely on that pod — memory spikes to 6.5GB on a 6GB node. autoscaler didn't add nodes because cpu was low.
lee: can we bump replicas or restart the failing pods? quick win: cordon & drain causes rebalance, so restart might help but could worsen lag if consumer rebalance takes long.
priya: heads-up from billing: if backlog > 12h we risk invoice mismatches for yesterday's batch. currently est backlog 1.2M msgs ~ 2.4 hours processing at current rate.
eva: any affected customers flagged? we have two enterprise customers with high usage — I'll draft a short PSA if this hits 4 hours.
alex: plan: 1) scale metering-consumer to 48 replicas (was 12) 2) temporarily disable aggressive rebalance: set max.poll.interval.ms higher 3) trigger a rolling restart of pods on nodes showing OOM. executing now.
maya: applying HPA patch: `kubectl -n metering patch hpa metering-consumer --patch '{"spec":{"maxReplicas":48}}'`
jon: increased parallelism on stream processors too: updated deployment consumers v2 -> replicas 48.
alex: restarting pods on nodes with OOM: `kubectl -n metering rollout restart deploy/metering-consumer`
incident-bot: PagerDuty note: alex acknowledged at 2167800025, escalation paused.
lee: monitoring: lag started dropping after restart, partitions rebalanced, commit errors cleared. lag now 420k. keep an eye.
priya: thanks — what's ETA to < 100k? need that to consider invoices safe for yesterday.
maya: at current throughput, ~30 min to hit 100k. still seeing a couple transient 502s from write path.
aleX: (typo) alex: corrected: transient 502s were upstream storage flaps, opened ticket with storage team.
jon: filed storage ticket ST-5582, they are investigating. retry logic is in place but added exponential backoff to reduce overload.
priya: ok please confirm once < 100k so we can unblock invoice run.
eva: I'll hold the customer comms draft until we see stable decline or ETA > 60min.
alex: handoff: my pager window ends in 18m. passing to lee for continued monitoring. lee are you available to take oncall?
lee: taking handoff. I'm oncall and will watch dashboards for 2 hours. if lag stalls or climbs, escalate back to platform-sre.
incident-bot: Handoff recorded: from alex -> lee. PD incident remains open.
maya: post-mortem notes being collected in doc: https://confluence.redwood/inci/metering-21678 — initial hypothesis: memory regression in consumer lib after dependency bump two days ago.
jon: I'll pin a revert PR to stopgap if we see another spike.
lee: monitoring: steady decline now; last check 210k. setting alert threshold to 300k to catch regressions.
priya: great — once below 100k we can resume invoice runs and I will confirm closure. keep me posted.
alex: thanks team. closing immediate actions. will follow-up in postmortem. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: PagerDuty note: incident acknowledged by lee at 2167800500.
pagerduty-bot: Incident PD12345 status: acknowledged -> assigned.
lee: update 21:40 UTC — backlog 92k. starting validation run for invoice ingestion.
priya: validation passed for sample customers. resuming invoice generation for yesterday's batch.
eva: sending customers courtesy note: "We experienced a temporary ingestion lag earlier today; processing completed and invoices were generated. No action required."
lee: closing play: triggered consumer backfill job to catch any residual items, job id backfill-216780. expected 15m.
incident-bot: PagerDuty note: incident resolved by lee at 2167801200. PD12345 closed.
priya: marking as invoice-risk mitigated. will include cost/impact estimates in postmortem.
maya: postmortem draft incoming. tagging: @platform, @billing, @sre.
jon: adding action item: add pod memory request bump and integrate OOM alert into runbook.
lee: confirmed. good catch everyone."
